channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Burning Sword: Death Sun
item.description: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a wuxia action game set in 12th-century China. Play as Zhang Yixian, cast down by the Elder of the Northern Mountain, and carve a bloody path back to him. Hardcore combat, epic boss battles, deep character progression, and an arena built for high scores.

item.title: Graveyard Orbit
item.description: A relaxing space mining incremental. Build your own ship. Clean up the galaxy’s wreckage, piece by piece. Cash in your haul for parts and upgrades. Enjoy the quiet satisfaction of leaving nothing behind.

item.title: KORRIDOR
item.description: Fight off hordes of demons in this unforgiving gates shooter! Slay monsters, pick up upgrades, and create overpowered builds to annihilate bosses while listening to heavy metal tracks. Many foes and secrets await you in the catacombs...

item.title: Lord of Undead
item.description: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

item.title: Marque & Reprisal
item.description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

item.title: Monster Girls Survival & Craft 2040
item.description: 2040. You wake in a city half-swallowed by another world. Dig anywhere, build anything - a shack, a castle, a fortress. Capture the monster girls roaming the wastes and they fight, work and live beside you. Every seventh night a horde comes. Raise walls, set traps and survive until dawn.

item.title: MR FARMBOY
item.description: MR FARMBOY is a colony farming game with automation. Build your dream farm, grow crops, raise animals, attract villagers, and hire workers to automate everything.

item.title: Toto's Journey
item.description: Toto’s Journey is a cozy adventure inspired by the world of The Wizard of Oz. Play as Toto, a brave dog lost in a magical world after a mysterious cyclone. Explore enchanted lands, meet unusual creatures, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way back home.

item.title: SAMURAI WARRIORS 4 DX
item.description: The sparks of destiny ignite in this rich depiction of the Warring States period that features a total of 55 different officers. The deluxe edition contains more than 150 previously released DLC from "SAMURAI WARRIORS 4," including costumes, weapons, customization parts, scenarios, and BGM!

item.title: The Last Gas Station: Winter Resort
item.description: Return to the old gas station years later, this time as a raccoon. Turn the snowbound backwoods into a winter resort with an ice rink, ski slopes, guided tours, and cozy cabins for your guests.

item.title: Trust Your Gut
item.description: A multi-ball roulette roguelite. Spin multiple balls at once and rewrite the wheel: add colors, change the numbers, rebalance payouts and stack multipliers with 100+ mementos and 50 trick balls. You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.

item.title: Amazing Frog?
item.description: Amazing Frog? is an openworld, sandbox, physics game. Grand Frog Auto in Swindon, with farting ragdoll frogs.

item.title: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard
item.description: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.

item.title: Crimson Moon
item.description: You are Nephilim: a human-angel hybrid forged to defend humanity with supernatural powers. Fight solo or with a friend to annihilate demons and challenge brutal bosses in relentless melée combat. Rise, violent one. The prophecy is yours to fulfill.

item.title: FATE: Reawakened
item.description: Reawaken the critically acclaimed FATE games like never before! Play all 4 classic dungeon crawler titles with enhanced graphics as you battle through challenging procedurally generated dungeons, learn powerful spells, and fish to your heart’s content. Are you up to the task? Your FATE awaits!
